modules.module_title: prepare raw material for preparing wax

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like beeswax, soy wax, paraffin wax, double boiler, pouring pot, color and essential oils
collect tools like silicone spatula and thermometer

modules.module_title: prepare three different waxes for making candle

pcs.pc_description: use soy wax, beeswax along with paraffin wax for the better quality.
make sure melting Paraffin wax at around 100 degrees
melt soy wax at approximately 124 degrees
melt bee wax at around 145 degrees

modules.module_title: melting solid form of wax by using double boiler technique

pcs.pc_description: pour the flakes into a pouring pot and measure the same amount again, because the flakes melt down so much.
melt solid form of wax is in a unique technique called double boiler method and slowly warm the wax, using spatula
follow this method of double boiler to melting the wax as it prevents the wax from catching flame and also controls the temperature.
use double boiler for melting the wax, 0.5/4th of water is poured into the boiler and the blocks of wax are allowed to melt at 50-55 degree Celsius approximately.
make sure the vertically lengthy candles, wax is melted at 59 degrees Celsius as to improve the long-lasting potency of the candles a hardening agent is added to wax.
add fragrance oil of about 15 to 30 ml to maximum 45kgs of wax to prepare beautifully aromatic candles.
use different types of fragrances are chocolate, bayberry, sandalwood, jasmine, ocean mist and few others.
adding color dyes in molten wax to make the candles colorful

modules.module_title: check quality standards of melting wax

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate the inspection process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate melting wax is being achieved
ensure melting and pouring process is done properly
check if double boiler method is done appropriately

modules.module_title: Carry out processing of raw material

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like Container or silicone baking mold, beeswax, soy wax, paraffin wax hot glue, hex nut, candle wick, metal holder or wick holder and cleaning cloth
collect tools like wick trimmer, butter knives and for measuring like digital scale and thermometer
cut 2 to4 wick to 25 approx. in length
tie each end of the wick with a hex nut
fill a tall jar with cold water and set it aside
fold the wick in half and knot the nuts at both ends in the center
dip the ends slowly into the wax
dip the wicks into a jar of cold water
return to hot wax and then to the cool water. Repeat for a total of 10 times
cut the weight as near to the nut as possible at the bottom
dipping the tapered candle back and forth between the wax and the water until the desired candle diameter is achieved

modules.module_title: Pouring molten wax to the silicone baking mold

pcs.pc_description: ensure glass container and metal molds (made from aluminium material) needs hot soapy water to clean.
use silicone baking mold to shape the remaining molten beeswax and add soy wax, paraffin wax to making the candles hard
check the container surface is clean of any dust, dirt or residue.
add the glue dot or hot glue to the bottom of the wick tab
attach the wick in the candle container by the help of a metal wick holder and also use chopsticks, pencils or even butter knives
carefully pour the wax, filling the candle container to just below the top of the rim.
pour slowly to minimize air bubbles and allowed it to cool

modules.module_title: Prepare cotton thread as the wick to light the candle

pcs.pc_description: mark requires length of cotton thread is cut according to the candle size.
make sure dip the metal part or wick tab into the melted wax and place it in the center of the bottom of the jar or container
use the wick centering device if the wick becomes unstuck from the bottom
remove the wax candle from the mold
trim the wick to about ¼ approx. of an inch
inspect the process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate quality of container and candle wick is achieved.
ensure placing of metal wick holder is done properly
ensure pouring wax slowly to minimize air bubbles is done properly
check the cutting length of wick is done appropriately
ensure a proper finish as per requirement
ensure the output delivered is defect free and toxic free
